I'm so sorry you're facing this incredibly difficult situation. Your brother's safety is at serious risk right now, and your concern for him shows how much you care.

Whether you can sign him into a facility depends on your state's laws and your legal relationship to him. In many states, any concerned person can petition for an emergency mental health evaluation, but the criteria usually focus on whether someone is a danger to themselves or others or is gravely disabled. Given what you've described, he may meet that threshold. I'd strongly encourage you to contact your local county mental health crisis team or call a crisis line like 988 to ask about the specific process in your area. They can guide you through emergency evaluation options and any legal steps available to you.

You might also consider contacting adult protective services or asking local law enforcement to do a welfare check if he's in immediate danger. You're doing the right thing by seeking help for him.
